source_classification.inference: Build 478 failure is causally consistent with fd22609f changing LATEST.next_executable_frontier without changing the bound run-06 receipt frontier; the installed validator rejects that disagreement.
source_classification.unresolved: Exact Buildkite step log for build 478 was not available through the connected provider surface; causal attribution is based on provider commit diff plus the validator's explicit frontier equality gate.
source_classification.prior_assistant_interpretation: The prior run reported continuity enforcement as green after build 477, but the later fd22609f pointer-only mutation was not re-bound to a new run receipt and left main red.

failure_pattern_attacked: Continuity metadata advanced beyond its bound source-bearing receipt, creating a self-contradictory recovery tuple; provider-state identifiers were also untyped 40-hex strings that could not distinguish same-repository commits from cross-repository commits or blobs.
concrete_outputs: same-repository commit reachability gate using git cat-file plus merge-base --is-ancestor
negative tests for nonexistent same-repository commits, untyped identifiers, and same-repository commits disguised as cross-repository references
new source-bearing run-07 receipt that re-binds the recovery frontier

counterevidence: The first assumption that build 480 represented a regression from the new provider-state tests was rejected after provider readback showed build 478 on the prior pointer-only commit was already failing.
The v2 migration is staged behind provider_state_schema_version so legacy state does not fail merely because the validator code lands before the pointer migration.

objective_state_delta.before: The forge pointer could contain arbitrary untyped 40-hex provider identifiers, and main was red because LATEST advanced its frontier without advancing the bound run receipt.
objective_state_delta.after: The validator has a versioned typed provider-state contract with same-repository reachability checks and adversarial tests, and run-07 provides the new source-bearing receipt needed to re-bind LATEST without repeating the run-06 frontier contradiction.

unresolved: The run-07 pointer migration still requires provider CI readback after LATEST is updated to v2.
Cross-repository commits and blob references are typed exceptions in v2 but are not yet independently provider-verified by CI.
The Operator-host skills lifecycle remains unverified because every registered Remote Desktop Commander device is offline.
next_executable_frontier: Upgrade typed provider exceptions from classification to proof: verify same-repository blob objects directly, bind cross-repository commit references to a durable provider-readback manifest with exact repository/object type/SHA and receipt digest, add tamper and nonexistent-object tests, and preserve host-runtime verification as a separate unresolved lane until an Operator device is online.
